_comment: Rater roster. Replace name/id with your three coders, then push; every push redeploys.
Order matters: allocation derives from a rater's position in this list, so reordering or
removing an entry reshuffles who codes what. To drop someone after coding has started,
leave the entry in place and set "active": false.
replication = how many independent coders see each narrative. At 3 coders, 2 gives a
disagreement signal on EVERY item (the outline's original design only double-coded 100 of
400) while keeping each coder near 3.5-5.5 hours. Raising it to 3 means everyone codes
calibration_n narratives are coded by ALL three. That block is the only place where all
three overlap, so it carries the pairwise kappas and the per-coder agreement score.
Coders do it first, and it is worth reviewing those 20 together BEFORE the rest is coded.
